claims.evidence: Witness report notes operational status of rig and hydraulics was not shown.
No service logs or dealer receipts were provided in the report.
Condition of internal components and drilling bits is unknown.
Photos 0, 1, and 2 show UD and Nissan Diesel branding on the grille.

risks.risk: Hydraulic system failure or major leaks in the drilling assembly.
risks.proof: A video showing the mast being raised, lowered, and the drill head rotating.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring a complete hydraulic system overhaul.

risks.risk: Engine or transmission failure in the Nissan Diesel truck.
risks.proof: Video of the engine running and the truck moving under its own power.

risks.risk: Drilling rig capacity (depth/diameter) is lower than standard for this class.
risks.proof: Photo of the manufacturer's data plate on the drilling rig unit itself.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest capacity for a 6x4 mounted rig.

risks.risk: Excessive wear on drilling rods and bits requiring immediate replacement.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rod threads and the cutting faces of the bits.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing a full set of new consumables.

proof_requests: Video of the drilling rig in full operation (mast movement and rotation).
Photos of the truck's dashboard with the engine running to see mileage and warning lights.
Photo of the rig's specification plate (not the truck's plate).
Scanned copies of the recent dealer service invoices.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Nissan Diesel UD 6x4 borehole rig. It will be priced at its worst-case (non-operational) value until functional proof is provided.
